title: Confusing Number
description: Determine if a number becomes a different valid number when rotated 180 degrees.
pseudocode:
1. map = {0:0, 1:1, 6:9, 8:8, 9:6}
2. original = n, rotated = 0
3. while n > 0:
4.   digit = n % 10
5.   if digit not in map: return false
6.   rotated = rotated * 10 + map[digit]
7.   n = floor(n / 10)
8. return rotated != original

steps.note: Initialize original number as 89 and rotated as 0.
